name: atlas-study-workspace-v1
description: Authored fictional lecture/lab/research/meeting/PDF logs with closely numbered controls. Representative workflow types, not representative personal data or measured real experiments. Parallel EN/KO evidence and deliberately absent measurements.

passages.text: AT-201 used a binary heap. The shortest-path run visited 48 vertices in 12 milliseconds; negative edges were excluded.
AT-201은 이진 힙을 사용했다. 최단 경로 실행은 정점 48개를 방문했고 12밀리초가 걸렸다. 음수 간선은 실험에서 제외했다.

Graph experiment procedure: record the run identifier AT-201 before beginning. Keep the raw log separately from discussion notes. Review missing measurements, disagreements and units during the next study meeting. A procedure sheet is not the measured result.
AT-210 used a linear scan instead of a heap. It visited the same 48 vertices in 39 milliseconds. This is a separate control run, not AT-201.
AT-210은 힙 대신 선형 탐색을 사용했다. 같은 정점 48개를 방문하는 데 39밀리초가 걸렸다. AT-201과는 별도 대조군이다.

Graph control procedure: record the run identifier AT-210 before beginning. Keep the raw log separately from discussion notes. Review missing measurements, disagreements and units during the next study meeting. A procedure sheet is not the measured result.
DB-318 copied the database with its write-ahead log committed through the backup API. The result contained 87 conversations and 14 edited notes. Vector files were excluded.
DB-318은 백업 API로 WAL의 커밋된 내용을 함께 복사했다. 결과에는 대화 87개와 편집된 노트 14개가 들어 있었다. 벡터 파일은 제외했다.

Database experiment procedure: record the run identifier DB-318 before beginning. Keep the raw log separately from discussion notes. Review missing measurements, disagreements and units during the next study meeting. A procedure sheet is not the measured result.
DB-381 restored 6 demonstration notes into a new folder. It did not overwrite the working database. This control has no record of 87 conversations.
DB-381은 시연 노트 6개를 새 폴더에 복원했다. 작업 중인 데이터베이스를 덮어쓰지 않았다. 대화 87개에 대한 기록은 이 대조군에 없다.

Database control procedure: record the run identifier DB-381 before beginning. Keep the raw log separately from discussion notes. Review missing measurements, disagreements and units during the next study meeting. A procedure sheet is not the measured result.
RS-044 compared two fictional coating recipes. Recipe Cedar dried in 18 minutes; recipe Birch dried in 31 minutes. The notebook did not measure durability or safety.
RS-044는 가상 코팅 레시피 두 개를 비교했다. Cedar는 18분, Birch는 31분 만에 건조했다. 내구성이나 안전성은 측정하지 않았다.

Research notes procedure: record the run identifier RS-044 before beginning. Keep the raw log separately from discussion notes. Review missing measurements, disagreements and units during the next study meeting. A procedure sheet is not the measured result.
RS-040 recorded room temperature as 22 degrees Celsius and humidity as 45 percent. It did not test Cedar or Birch. This environmental log does not establish recipe durability.
RS-040의 실내 온도는 섭씨 22도, 습도는 45퍼센트였다. Cedar나 Birch를 시험하지 않았다. 환경 기록으로 코팅 내구성을 판단할 수 없다.

Research control procedure: record the run identifier RS-040 before beginning. Keep the raw log separately from discussion notes. Review missing measurements, disagreements and units during the next study meeting. A procedure sheet is not the measured result.
SM-812 allocated 25 minutes to source inspection and 10 minutes to questions. The room was Kauri 3. Attendance was capped at 16 people, not 160.
SM-812는 출처 확인에 25분, 질문에 10분을 배정했다. 장소는 Kauri 3이며 인원 상한은 160명이 아닌 16명이었다.

Seminar agenda procedure: record the run identifier SM-812 before beginning. Keep the raw log separately from discussion notes. Review missing measurements, disagreements and units during the next study meeting. A procedure sheet is not the measured result.
SM-821 recorded 13 attendees and a decision to postpone the export demo. The group requested a saved PDF sample before the next meeting. It did not change the SM-812 agenda.
SM-821에는 참석자 13명과 export 시연 연기 결정이 기록됐다. 모임은 다음 회의 전에 저장된 PDF 샘플을 요청했다. SM-812 일정은 변경하지 않았다.

Seminar minutes procedure: record the run identifier SM-821 before beginning. Keep the raw log separately from discussion notes. Review missing measurements, disagreements and units during the next study meeting. A procedure sheet is not the measured result.
PX-606 contained 8 physical PDF pages. Text extraction found text on pages 1, 2, 4, 6 and 8. Pages 3, 5 and 7 had no extracted text; no OCR or scan classification was performed.
PX-606 PDF는 8쪽이었다. 1, 2, 4, 6, 8쪽에서 텍스트를 추출했고 3, 5, 7쪽은 텍스트가 없었다. OCR이나 스캔 분류는 수행하지 않았다.

PDF capture log procedure: record the run identifier PX-606 before beginning. Keep the raw log separately from discussion notes. Review missing measurements, disagreements and units during the next study meeting. A procedure sheet is not the measured result.
PX-660 was a four-page PDF with extracted text on all four pages. The associated Markdown note had no physical page numbers. PX-660 is not the eight-page PX-606 sample.
PX-660은 4쪽 모두에서 텍스트를 추출한 PDF였다. 함께 저장된 Markdown 노트에는 실제 페이지 번호가 없다. 8쪽인 PX-606과 다른 샘플이다.

PDF capture control procedure: record the run identifier PX-660 before beginning. Keep the raw log separately from discussion notes. Review missing measurements, disagreements and units during the next study meeting. A procedure sheet is not the measured result.
